notes: INPI Brazil trademark fees are quoted per-class in BRL for application (pre-approved vs free specification), the first 10-year term, renewal (10-yr cycle), opposition, cancellation, and administrative invalidation. Per-class amounts are flagged via FeeCondition(classes_over=1, per_unit=True). Up-to-60% discount applies per Resolution 251/2019 §I.5 for individuals, SMEs, cooperatives, ICTs, non-profits, and public bodies.
